REQ-4 Same window and rule as the dashboard No-shows tile — known — reuse the tile's Last 30 days window and rule.
GET /api/doctors/:id — changed: adds the count and window bounds to the response.
as a link to `/appointments?…` with doctor, No-show and window

findings.suggested_fix: Name the response fields, e.g. no_show_count:int, no_show_window:{start,end} as ISO UTC strings, and give the link's query parameter names. Mark the parameter names as provisional until Q-01 is answered.
findings.text: The interface is not precise. The design says GET /api/doctors/:id adds the count and window bounds, but gives no field names or types (for example, ISO UTC strings). It also gives no query parameter names for the /appointments link.

cites.quote: fromDoctor keeps mapping only editable fields, so the count never enters the form or PATCH body.

findings.suggested_fix: Cite the fromDoctor and PATCH validation source lines. If they cannot be cited, move the claim to Unknown and add a check in Q-03.
findings.text: The design states as fact that fromDoctor maps only editable fields and that PATCH does not accept the count. Neither is cited. The impact step asked design to confirm this against the current source, and the context pack lags the source.

cites.quote: Lists answer `{ items, page, page_size, total }`, 20 per page.
then the number of appointments listed equals the count shown on the doctor page.

findings.suggested_fix: State that the list total (not the page length) equals the count, and that the link opens on page 1.
findings.text: S-2 AC2 requires the list to show as many appointments as the count. Lists are paged at 20 per page, and the design does not say that the comparison uses the list total.

cites.quote: returns the window [start, end) in UTC for "last 30 days up to end of today" in HOSPITAL_TZ
can the dashboard's Last 30 days window be extracted to `api/src/lib` unchanged?

findings.suggested_fix: Describe the helper as returning whatever window DashboardService computes today, and note that REQ-2/REQ-3 are checked against it.
findings.text: The shared helper is described with a fixed definition, a half-open window '[start, end) for last 30 days up to end of today'. Q-02 says the dashboard rule will be extracted unchanged, so this definition may not match the dashboard rule.

cites.quote: PATCH /api/doctors/:id — existing: does not accept the count.

findings.suggested_fix: Move the endpoint lines into a separate Endpoints section.
findings.text: The Components section lists endpoints as if they were components, which blurs the components/endpoints split used in the front matter.

questions.text: If Q-02 finds that DashboardService has no Last 30 days No-shows period, REQ-4 cannot be met as written. Should Q-02 be blocking rather than non-blocking for this design?

rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing layers and modules: route, service, repo, lib helper, existing index and API client. No new infrastructure, store or endpoint. This matches architecture#components and conventions#code-layout.
S-1 and S-2 are both mapped to components and every REQ is listed under Known. The design does not say how the link list's count matches when the list is paged, which S-2 AC2 needs.
Methods and paths are exact. But the new response field names, the window-bound shape and the /appointments link query parameter names are not given.

The unknowns are tracked as U-1..U-3 with questions. The claims about fromDoctor mapping only editable fields and PATCH not accepting the count are stated as facts without citation, and the context pack lag is not noted.
Four trade-offs each explain their reason: which endpoint carries the count, extracting vs re-implementing the window rule, server-side window bounds, and no caching.
Readable and consistent with the impact artifact. The Components section mixes endpoints into the component list.
